name: DisplayLink USB display adapters and docks
summary: USB docks and adapters that add screens over USB using Synaptics' DisplayLink software instead of the computer's own video output. Screens on them stay black until that software is installed.

darwin.notes: Install Synaptics' free DisplayLink Manager app and allow it Screen Recording in System Settings > Privacy & Security. No kernel extension and no security changes are needed. This is also how base M1 and M2 MacBook Air and 13-inch MacBook Pro models get more than one external screen.

win32.notes: Windows Update usually installs the DisplayLink driver by itself. If the screens stay black, install the latest driver from Synaptics.

linux.notes: Synaptics publishes a driver for Ubuntu (it uses the evdi kernel module). Other distributions have community packages. Not tested by Plug Doctor on every distribution.
